Avora browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Avora FY-6 Super Fuzz Published on November 5, 2007 Avora fuzz pedal Information The Avora FY-6 Super Fuzz is one of many branded versions of this Japanese OEM circuit, sold under different names in the late 1960s and early 1970s. It produces the classic snarling, octave-infused fuzz tones that became a defining sound of early heavy rock. Controls Expander (with On/Off switch): Adjusts the intensity of the fuzz effect and doubles as the main power switch. Balance: Controls the overall output volume. Tone switch: Two-way slide switch; Position 1 selects a mid-forward fuzz tone, Position 2 adds a thicker sustained tone with emphasized low end. Push button switch: Top-mounted bypass switch to engage or cut the effect. Specifications Power: Standard 9V battery (replaceable by removing the bottom plate with 4 screws) Connections: Input jack, Output jack Model: FY-6 Highlights Part of the family of OEM-built Super Fuzz pedals Identical circuit to several other rebranded models Known for aggressive, cutting fuzz with pronounced octave overtones Collectible and historically significant in the fuzz lineage Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Related Guyatone FS-3 Fuzz (related?)
